properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored ethereumj library — the wallet's secp256k1 ECDSA system. Constants.java defines the curve order N (used by ECKey.verify to range-check r/s), ECKey.java:64 loads X9ECParameters via SECNamedCurves.getByName("secp256k1"), and jce/ECKeyPairGenerator + ECAlgorithmParameters feed ECGenParameterSpec("secp256k1") into a JCE KeyPairGenerator for wallet key generation. This is the curve every Ethereum transaction signature in the app is made on; Shor-vulnerable signature primitive, migration ML-D

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: feature/wallet-info KS.java — the wallet-authentication gate. An AES key is generated inside the Android Keystore (KeyGenerator.getInstance(KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, ANDROID_KEY_STORE), line 55) and used with CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "AES/CBC/PKCS7Padding" via Cipher.getInstance at lines 74 and 145 to encrypt/decrypt the authentication payload. CBC without an authenticated-encryption construction: malleable unless a MAC is applied separately; migration AES-256-GCM. First-party code, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored Keccak implementation (cryptohash package, bitcoinj-derived KeccakCore/Keccak256/Keccak512) plus its HashUtil.sha3()/sha3OfLength() wrappers (lines 42, 48, 55, 61). Keccak-256 is Ethereum's transaction/RLP hash — load-bearing for address and transaction-hash derivation in the vendored ethereumj stack. Hash primitive: no Shor exposure, Grover margin intact; kept as inventory of what the wallet actually runs. First-party vendored source, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two distinct SHA-256 uses. (1) StringToIntConverter.kt:18 — non-security purpose: hashing a promotion string down to an Int used as an alarm request code. (2) HashUtil.java:27 — the vendored ethereumj shared digest (doubleSha256 at lines 95-99), part of the blockchain hashing utility. SHA-256 retains a 128-bit quantum margin under Grover; kept as inventory of what the build uses.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The SecureRandom instances that back wallet key generation and authentication: ECKey.java's static secureRandom feeds ECKeyPairGenerator.getInstance (line 87) for secp256k1 wallet keygen; Utils.java:18 is ethereumj's shared SecureRandom; TrustPasswordStore.kt:92 (wallet-info authentication) generates randomness for the keystore-protected password store. A DRBG asset — the randomness source of the app's EC keygen; SecureRandom is the correct choice here, so this is inventory of the keygen PRNG, n
